name: fit a full transformer-inference engine under a strict source-size budget
definition: implement the entire forward pass (embeddings, layers, normalization, vocabulary projection) as compact, dependency-free source limited to a specified byte size and compilable with a given command line.
failure_mode: overshooting the byte cap or failing to build with the mandated compiler flags fails regardless of correctness.

name: fit a parametric bayesian network over the discovered structure
definition: estimate conditional/distributed parameters under the recovered DAG so that resampled statistics match reference parametric forms within the verifier's statistical tolerance.
failure_mode: inaccurate fitted coefficients shift the sampled distribution off the reference and fail the KS test

name: gpg-encrypt an archive and remove plaintext intermediates
definition: Produce a GPG symmetric AES-256 encrypted file that decrypts to the original archive bytes and ensure no unencrypted intermediate remains.
failure_mode: Wrong cipher or passphrase handling makes decryption/extraction fail.

name: implement a runnable mips ELF interpreter
definition: write a JS vm that loads an elf, decodes the instruction stream, and emulates the registers/memory correctly
failure_mode: misemulated instructions stall or crash the boot
